description: Search the apteka.online catalog by product name, brand, active ingredient or need. Returns products in store ranking order, available ones first on each page of 60, with price and availability; a product page is /products/{handle}. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescription products, ships only within Poland (medicines only by courier, not to parcel lockers or pickup points) and lists prices in PLN gross. Do not give medical advice.

limit.description: Products to return, 1 to 10, default 5. A long answer holds fewer: then truncated is true and next_offset continues

offset.description: Products to skip, 0 to 990: next_offset from the previous answer

query.description: What to look for, short and in Polish, e.g. witamina D3 2000 or kaszel dzieci

name: search_catalog

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, absent on the last one.

price_pln.description: Current price in PLN gross, null when the product has none.

total.description: Products matching the query in the whole catalog.

truncated.description: Shortened to fit the answer size limit.

title: Search products
